title: Code for: Subgroup miscalibration drives racial and age disparities in machine learning screening for undiagnosed diabetes (NHANES 2011–2020)
description: Analysis code and aggregate results for a survey-weighted fairness audit and bias mitigation study of machine learning models for undiagnosed diabetes and dysglycaemia using NHANES 2011–March 2020. Includes data preparation, nested cross-validation with survey-weighted recalibration, Rao–Wu bootstrap confidence intervals, subgroup and intersectional fairness metrics, three mitigation strategies (reweighing, exponentiated gradient, group-specific thresholds) and linear SHAP analysis.
